one_line: Empirical study of 84 Italian pharmaceutical-manufacturing (NACE 21.20, drug formulation/mixing/filling/finishing — batch, not continuous) energy audits to derive energy performance indicators and energy-saving actions; continuous-flow sectors (cement, glass, foundries, chemicals) appear only as methodological or comparison references.
